entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Namaste!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ***BIG NEWS***

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I looked up my uncle...[n]and I got a hit in Mementos!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Would you be angry if[n]I asked for your help?
Of course I wouldn't.
Maybe a bit.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I can't do much by myself though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I might be able to boost his[n]debt by a million yen or so...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But that wouldn't really solve the problem.
It looks like I have no[n]choice but to accept...
Just this once.
I guess I can't say no.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Really!? Thanks a bunch!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My uncle's name is Youji[n]Isshiki. Let's go to Mementos[n]and change his heart.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But, uh... I have a favor to ask.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't really wanna tell[n]everybody about the time I[n]spent living with him...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Maybe someday, sure...[n]but today's not that day.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So I was thinking... can we[n]maybe go just the two of us?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I really need your help here,[n][fName]! Pleeeeeeeeeeeease!
I need to take care of Futaba's[n]uncle and help Sojiro...
